semantics.claim: Amounts in OrderFilled are gross in every generation: shares = takerAmountFilled for BUY, makerAmountFilled for SELL; cash = the other field. Integer units, 6 decimals for collateral and shares.
semantics.evidence: per-owner reconciliation of 14 receipts, reconcile_summary.json / v1_fee_check.json: zero unexplained mismatches

semantics.claim: 2026 exchanges and ExchangeV3: fee is charged in pUSD to the owner of the order whose OrderFilled.fee>0 (maker or taker). BUY owner pays makerAmountFilled+fee pUSD and receives exactly takerAmountFilled shares; SELL owner gives makerAmountFilled shares and receives takerAmountFilled-fee pUSD. The fee goes directly to FeeCharged.receiver (0x115f48dc..). sum(FeeCharged.amount) == sum(OrderFilled.fee).
Makers can pay a fee on the 2026 exchanges (maker fills with fee>0 seen).
semantics.evidence: negrisk2026_fee li134/137 maker 0x0a648686.. fee 400 and 74990 deducted in pUSD; ctf2026_fee li224 maker fee 1501730

semantics.claim: V1: OrderFilled.fee is withheld by the exchange in the asset the owner RECEIVES (shares for BUY, collateral for SELL; FeeCharged.tokenId names it) and sent to the operator (FeeCharged.receiver = tx operator). When the operator is a fee module it refunds part or all in the same tx. Net fee = OrderFilled.fee - refund; owner receives takerAmountFilled - netFee.
semantics.evidence: v1_ctf_2026_fee (66 fills) and v1_negrisk_2026_fee (4 fills): FeeRefunded.refund + FeeRefunded.feeCharged == OrderFilled.fee and to == owner for 70/70 fills, owner flows match with 0 mismatches; v1_2025_fee 0x190172c6.. (2025-03-11): fees 5000/50000 shares withheld per fill then fully refunded by FeeRefunded(address,address,uint256,uint256) of 0x78769d50 (refund explains mismatches exactly: True)

semantics.claim: V1 with zero fee: owners pay/receive exactly the OrderFilled amounts.
semantics.evidence: v1_ctf_2025_zero_fee 0xee9855df.. (block 76000027, 2025-09-03), v1_negrisk_2025_zero_fee 0x3bdc9333.. (block 76000000)

semantics.claim: V1 FeeCharged logs: 42 logs in 27 txs within blocks 65500000-69000000 (blocks 65533744-68934618, the last on 2025-03-11); none in 69000000-81000000; more than 20000 in 81000000-86127000.
semantics.evidence: v1_feecharged_scan.json, receipt_picks.json notes; tenderly errors above 20000 results (seen), so a 0 is a real 0

semantics.claim: Taker semantics: each maker order's OrderFilled has taker = the taker order's owner; the taker's own OrderFilled has taker = the exchange contract and is logged after the maker fills, immediately followed by OrdersMatched whose takerOrderHash/takerOrderMaker/amounts equal that own fill.
semantics.evidence: taker_check.json: 13 receipts across all 5 exchanges, all checks true

semantics.claim: Economic counterparty: for a maker fill it is OrderFilled.taker (the taker's owner address); for the taker's own fill (taker == exchange) the counterparties are the makers of the other OrderFilled logs between the previous OrdersMatched and this one. Shares can come from a mint (split) or go to a merge, so complementary-token makers are counterparties too.
semantics.evidence: v1_ctf_2025_zero_fee: 4 BUY makers of token ..105567 vs taker BUY of complement ..173989, 4 CTF PositionSplit in the same tx
